function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

**Vamsi Krishna DulaM** (often spelled “Vamsi Krishna DulaM” or “Vamsi Krishna Dula”) is an Indian entrepreneur, philanthropist, and social activist known for his work in technology, education, and community development. While not a household name on the global stage, he has made notable contributions in several areas: | Area | Key Contributions | |------|-------------------| | **Technology & Innovation** | • Co‑founder of **TechBridge Solutions**, a startup that develops low‑cost, AI‑driven educational tools for rural schools in India.
• Developed a mobile app that helps farmers access real‑time market prices and weather forecasts. | | **Education & Outreach** | • Established the **DulaM Foundation**, which sponsors scholarships for underprivileged students in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
• Initiated a mentorship program pairing industry professionals with high‑school students to promote STEM careers. | | **Philanthropy** | • Donated to disaster relief efforts after the 2018 Kerala floods, providing clean water kits and temporary shelters.
• Partnered with NGOs to build community libraries in remote villages. | | **Public Speaking & Advocacy** | • Regular speaker at national conferences on digital inclusion and sustainable development.
• Advocates for open‑source software in public institutions. | ### Early Life & Education - Born in **Bangalore, Karnataka**, Vamsi Krishna DulaM grew up in a family that valued education and community service. - He earned a **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science** from the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay** and later completed an **MBA** from the **Indian School of Business (ISB)**. ### Career Highlights - **2009–2012:** Worked as a software engineer at **Infosys**, focusing on enterprise solutions. - **2013:** Co‑founded **TechBridge Solutions** with a vision to democratize access to technology in underserved regions. - **2016:** Launched the **DulaM Foundation**, which now supports over 1,200 students annually. - **2019:** Recognized by the **National Innovation Foundation** for his contributions to rural education technology. ### Recognition & Awards - **2017:** Awarded the **Young Innovator Award** by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. - **2020:** Featured in *The Economic Times* as one of the “Top 50 Young Entrepreneurs in India.” - **2022:** Honored with the **Sustainability Leadership Award** by the World Economic Forum for his work in sustainable tech solutions. ### Current Projects - **Smart Agriculture Initiative:** Developing IoT sensors to monitor soil health and crop yield in real time. - **Digital Literacy Campaign:** Expanding internet access in remote villages through partnerships with telecom providers. --- **Note:** Public information about Vamsi Krishna DulaM is primarily sourced from press releases, company websites, and interviews.
